user.title: Choose Control Method
user.description: Select how you want to control your Atomberg device. Cloud control requires API credentials and supports fans, water purifiers, and smart locks. IR control requires an infrared emitter device and is fan-only.

cloud.title: Atomberg Cloud Configuration
cloud.description: Input the credentials for the Atomberg Cloud API used for supported fans, water purifiers, and smart locks.

ir.title: Atomberg IR Configuration
ir.description: Select your fan model and the infrared transmitter entity to use for controlling your Atomberg fan.

data_description.fan_model: The model of your Atomberg fan.
data_description.ir_emitter_entity: The infrared transmitter entity to use for sending commands.

error.unknown: An unknown error occurred. See log for details.

abort.no_ir_emitters: No infrared transmitter entities found. Please set up an infrared device first (e.g., ESPHome IR proxy).

data_description.use_cloud_control: When enabled, the integration will send control commands to the Atomberg cloud APIs instead of directly to the device.
data_description.purifier_poll_interval: How often water purifier and smart lock state (and fan analytics) are fetched from the Atomberg cloud. Adjustable from 20 to 60 minutes. The default of 30 minutes uses 48 of the API's 100 calls per day. Use the 'Refresh now' button to fetch immediately without waiting for this interval.
